officeLeaseSignals.description: Companies that have recently signed or announced new commercial office leases are the highest-value furniture buying prospect
signalSources: Commercial real estate announcement platforms (CBRE, JLL, Cushman & Wakefield press releases)
Local business media (Business Acumen, AFR, Herald, Courier Mail)
Company website 'New Office' or 'We're Moving' announcements
Job advertisements listing a new office address different to current address
officeLeaseSignals.timeToDecision: Companies with a new lease typically make furniture decisions 8–16 weeks after signing. They are most receptive to contact in weeks 2–8 after announcement.
officeLeaseSignals.urgencyProfile: High — there is a move-in deadline. Every week of delay compresses their planning window.

hiringSignals.description: Rapid hiring is a strong indicator of space pressure and upcoming furniture needs
hiringSignals.threshold: Companies posting 5+ new roles in a 4-week window are likely to face a space planning event within 3–6 months

fundingSignals.description: Recent investment rounds typically trigger office upgrades and team expansion
fundingSignals.highValueRounds: Series A ($5M+) and above — strong signal for significant furniture investment
fundingSignals.timeline: Furniture purchasing typically follows funding by 2–6 months as new hires are onboarded

mergersAndAcquisitions.description: M&A activity often triggers office consolidation or new headquarters setup
mergersAndAcquisitions.signal: Post-M&A integration commonly involves furniture replacement at the combined office

leaseExpirySignals.description: Companies 12–18 months from lease expiry are evaluating renew vs relocate. Either path likely triggers furniture investment.
leaseExpirySignals.howToIdentify: Commercial lease terms are typically 3, 5, or 7 years. Research when a known client or prospect moved into their current office.
leaseExpirySignals.opportunity: Approach with a 'workplace refresh assessment' — framing the conversation around the current office rather than a sales pitch

newMarketEntrants.description: Interstate or international companies opening Australian offices are very high-value prospects — they have budget, urgency, and no existing local supplier relationships
newMarketEntrants.approach: Lead with local market knowledge (Sydney, Brisbane, Melbourne fit-out regulations, preferred building management contacts) — this is highly valued by companies new to the Australian market

commercialRealEstateAgents.description: Commercial real estate agents know which companies are signing leases before it becomes public
commercialRealEstateAgents.strategy: Build relationships with lease agents at CBRE, JLL, Colliers, Knight Frank in Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne — offer referral arrangements
commercialRealEstateAgents.value: One active commercial agent referring tenants can generate 5–15 qualified project leads per year

interiorDesigners.description: Interior designers and workplace consultants are specified into projects before furniture decisions — getting specified means bypassing competitive tender
interiorDesigners.strategy: Provide designers with product catalogues, sample kits, spec sheets, and a trade pricing arrangement
interiorDesigners.value: A single loyal designer/consultant relationship can generate $300,000–$1,000,000+ in annual referral revenue
